modes: 3 M3G bind/release + copy, depth attached, NO clear
4 M3G RGB clear + copy, depth attached
5 M3G RGB+Z clear + copy, depth attached
6 M3G RGB clear + copy, NO depth attachment
7 M3G directly on Canvas RGB+Z, optional support

controls.key9: S1 sleep(1) / S0 no intentional sleep

measurement.Q: request timestamp to paint entry, requested samples only
measurement.P: previous measured paint body including HUD/state restoration
measurement.G: previous measured paint end to next paint start; includes statistics/return/loop/display/scheduling, NOT pure OS wait
measurement.identity: sumI == sumP + sumG exactly; displayed integer means rounded down independently
measurement.svc: LAST serviceRepaints wall duration; overlaps paint, never add to I/P/G
measurement.sleep: LAST actual sleep(1) wall duration; S0 skips Thread.sleep entirely, not sleep(0); clock is coarse
measurement.clock: System.currentTimeMillis, coarse wall time; displayed tenth-ms averages are NOT sub-ms clock resolution; 0.0 does NOT prove free; not GPU timestamps

buffers: Image/native helper lazy cold allocation once; Image recreated only on resize; no geometry or texture uploads
pump: default same sleep(1) in both; key9 explicitly disables sleep for either pump; at most one outstanding request; monitor released before repaint/serviceRepaints; QUEUED waits for paint completion without flooding
unsupported: per-mode explicit failure, no silent target fallback; other modes remain selectable
purpose: Locate the ~24ms outside existing native-path timer; no promised handset speedup.
